title: fix(plugin-detail): record:details edit mode edits a markdown field in a multi-line textarea (objectui#11541)
body:
Fixes #11541
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`record:details` edit mode now gives a `markdown` field an editor: the fields package's multi-line `TextAreaField`.

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts`: `markdown` joins `DETAIL_ROUTED_INLINE_TYPES`, the detail page's carve-out from the fields package's shared `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES` (the carve-out the upload widgets already use). Both detail hosts (`DetailSection`, `HeaderHighlight`) read it through `isInlineExcludedDetailFieldType`, so both now open the editor. `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES` is untouched, so a grid cell still excludes `markdown`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`: a routed `markdown` branch renders `TextAreaField`, and `markdown` joins `INLINE_ROUTED_FIELD_TYPES`. The `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` docblock no longer says the hosts never open an editor for markdown.
- `html` and `richtext`: unchanged, still excluded.
- Drift guard `inlineEditTypeCoverage.test.tsx`: `markdown` moves from `excluded` to `routed`.
- One `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch changeset.

## objectui#4228's reason, read first (the ruling's stop condition)

objectui#4228's blast-radius table records its detail-row reason for `markdown`: "heavy editor; a one-line text box is lossy". The shared set's own comment is "Heavy / full editors — better in the record form than a cell", which is an argument about a grid cell. Neither holds for a multi-line editor in a detail row, so the stop condition does not fire.

## Deviation from the ruling's wording: `textarea` has no multi-line editor in `record:details`

The ruling says "`markdown` gets the multi-line editor `textarea` already uses in `record:details` edit mode". Measured on `origin/main` `c476be0`: `textarea` is a member of `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES`, so in `record:details` edit mode it edits in the terminal plain-text input, an INPUT element of type text. That is a ONE-line box, the very "one-line text box" objectui#4228 kept markdown out of.

- Chromium 141 (headless, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`): an INPUT of type text given the value `"# T\n\npara\n"` reads back `"# Tpara"`. A TEXTAREA reads back the bytes it was given. HTML value sanitization for a text input strips line breaks.
- happy-dom 20.11.2 (this repo's test environment) answers the same: `"# Tpara"`.
- Component level, at `c476be0`: `InlineFieldInput` with `type: 'textarea'` and a multi-line value renders that INPUT, its value reads `"# TitleFirst paragraph.- a- b"`, and one keystroke emits the flattened string.

Routing markdown onto textarea's branch would therefore land it on the lossy box and fail the ruling's own pin ("its save reads back unchanged, newlines included"). Ablation leg A below measures exactly that. The ruling's intent, a multi-line editor that is lossless for a stored string, is met with `TextAreaField`: the fields package's multi-line widget, the one a `textarea` field edits with in the record form and in a grid cell (`FieldEditWidget` maps `textarea` to it). As a consequence `markdown` lands in the drift guard's `routed` bucket, not in `textarea`'s `benign` one.

## Pins

New file `InlineFieldInput.markdownEditor-11541.test.tsx`. Its values carry blank lines and a trailing newline, and are compared byte for byte.

- `InlineFieldInput`: a TEXTAREA seeded with the stored value, never the terminal input; typing emits the exact string; `autoFocus` lands on it.
- `DetailSection`: the pencil shows on a markdown row; edit mode renders one editor, seeded byte-identical.
- `HeaderHighlight`: the same editor inside the edit session.
- Save round trip: `InlineEditProvider` + `DetailSection` + `InlineEditSaveBar` over a store-backed `update`. The PATCH body is exactly the notes field set to the edited string, the store holds it, and re-entering edit seeds the editor with it.
- `html` / `richtext`: no pencil and no editor on either host.
- Grid: `plugin-grid`'s `inline-edit-options.test.ts` gains one assertion, `isFieldInlineEditable({ type: 'markdown' })` is false, at the grid's own gate.

## Verification

At `950c768` (the change itself):

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/plugin-detail^..." --filter="@object-ui/plugin-grid^..." --concurrency=2`: 13 of 13 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check`: both Done, exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` confirms both test projects compile the touched test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-detail/ packages/plugin-grid/src/inline-edit-options.test.ts`: Test Files 233 passed, 1 skipped (234); Tests 2318 passed, 8 skipped.

Ablations, run after the change was committed. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob must change) with an EXIT/INT/TERM restore; each restore is proven by the blob hash equal to HEAD's and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Leg A, the ruling's literal route (markdown falls to textarea's terminal input): 8 failed, 159 passed. The first failure prints the text INPUT holding the value.
- Leg B, no carve-out (`markdown` removed from `DETAIL_ROUTED_INLINE_TYPES`): 7 failed, 160 passed (both hosts, the round trip, the blast-radius row, the drift guard's partition).
- Leg C, `markdown` removed from the shared `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES`: the grid pin goes red, 1 failed, 14 passed.

At `c65a031` (final head; a typing-only follow-up that removes two `as any` casts and one `any` parameter annotation):

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the six touched or adjacent test files: 6 files, 215 tests passed.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. The warnings are all `no-explicit-any`; one is on a line this PR adds, the new markdown branch's `field as any`, written the way its sibling branches are.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new, HEAD `c65a031`), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0.
- Declared narrowing: the full `plugin-detail` suite ran at `950c768` and was not re-run at `c65a031`. The difference between them is type-only. CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, reported for the seat, not changed here: in `record:details` edit mode a `textarea` field edits in the one-line terminal input, so a stored multi-line value loses its line breaks on the first keystroke and the save writes the flattened text (measured above). This PR leaves `textarea` alone; the `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` docblock now says the line-break loss holds for it, instead of letting "nothing is lost" read as covering it.
- The record form edits `markdown` with `RichTextField` (a Textarea plus a format header). This PR follows the ruling's "the multi-line editor `textarea` uses" and routes to `TextAreaField`. Moving the detail row to `RichTextField` would be a one-line change if the maintainer prefers the form's own markdown widget.
- The brief expected existing textarea save pins in `InlineFieldInput.test.tsx`; there are none. The round-trip harness follows `InlineEditSaveBar.cascadePruneWire-10291.test.tsx`.
- objectui#11512's `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` is not touched.
